title: Left-bank configuration frame
statement: Let $S,H$ be state sets, let $k,l$ be natural numbers, let $e:S\to H$ be a state map, let $w,s,u,v$ be Boolean words, and let $q\in S$. Embed the seam configuration on input $w$ with state $q$ and the standard $k$-tape word assignment for $u$ into the host layout: tape $0$ holds $s$, the next $k$ tapes form the width bank, and the final $l$ tapes form the suffix bank. Using the ambient layout with the width bank initially empty and the suffix bank holding $v$, with all ambient head positions at $0$ and empty output prefix, and then applying $e$ to the state, gives the seam configuration with state $e(q)$ and the full host word layout.
replaced:
Relocating a canonical state-word configuration of the width-call machine
into the host layout --- with the candidate and suffix words preserved on
their ambient tapes --- yields exactly the host's canonical configuration on
the full word layout with the width word installed.
